entries.title: Psalms 35:1
segments: A Psalm of David. Strive, O LORD, with those who strive with me; fight against those who fight against me.

entries.title: Psalms 35:2
segments: Take hold of a shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

entries.title: Psalms 35:3
segments: Also draw out the spear and the lance against those who pursue me; say to my soul, I [am] your salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 35:4
segments: Let them be humbled and put to shame, those who seek after my soul; let them be turned back and be brought to blushing, those who plot evil to me.

entries.title: Psalms 35:5
segments: Let them be as chaff before the wind; and let the Angel of the LORD drive [them] away.

entries.title: Psalms 35:6
segments: Let their way be dark and slippery; and let the Angel of the LORD pursue them.

entries.title: Psalms 35:7
segments: For without cause they have spread their net for me [in] a pit-net; without cause they have dug for my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 35:8
segments: Let destruction come upon him, he will not know; and let his net which he has hidden concealed catch him, let him fall in it, into destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 35:9
segments: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD; it shall rejoice in His salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 35:10
segments: All my bones shall say, O LORD, who [is] like You, who delivers the poor from those stronger than he; yea, the poor and the needy from him who plunders him?

entries.title: Psalms 35:11
segments: Cruel witnesses rose up; they asked of me that which I never knew.

entries.title: Psalms 35:12
segments: They rewarded me evil for good; bereaving my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 35:13
segments: But when they were sick, my clothing [was] sackcloth; I humbled my soul with fastings; and my prayer returned into my own bosom.

entries.title: Psalms 35:14
segments: As a friend, as to my brother, I walked; as one who mourns for a mother, I was bowed down, mourning.

entries.title: Psalms 35:15
segments: But in my stumbling they rejoiced, and gathered themselves; the defamers gathered themselves against me, and I knew not; they tore and were not silent,

entries.title: Psalms 35:16
segments: with the hypocrites, mockers, [for] a cake, they gnashed on me with their teeth.

entries.title: Psalms 35:17
segments: O LORD, how long will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, my only one from the lions.

entries.title: Psalms 35:18
segments: I will give You thanks in the great congregation; I will praise You among a mighty people.

entries.title: Psalms 35:19
segments: Let not those who are my lying enemies rejoice over me, those who hate me without cause wink [with] the eye.

entries.title: Psalms 35:20
segments: For they do not speak peace; but they think deceitful things against the quiet ones of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 35:21
segments: And they widen their mouths against me; they say, Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen.

entries.title: Psalms 35:22
segments: You have seen, O LORD; do not keep silence; O LORD, do not be far from me.

entries.title: Psalms 35:23
segments: Stir up Yourself and awaken to my judgment, to my cause, my God and my Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 35:24
segments: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to Your righteousness; and do not let them rejoice over me.

entries.title: Psalms 35:25
segments: Let them not say in their hearts, Aha! Our Soul! Let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

entries.title: Psalms 35:26
segments: Let them be clothed [with] shame and dishonor together, [those] who magnify themselves over me.

entries.title: Psalms 35:27
segments: Let those who delight in my justification shout and rejoice; and they shall say without ceasing, The Lord be magnified, delighting in the peace of His servant.

entries.title: Psalms 35:28
segments: And my tongue shall speak of Your righteousness, of Your praise all the day long.
